highlights: 4 arenas: entry level, free battles and rewards.
1. Opens every Monday at 01:00 (Server Time).
2. Ends every Sunday at 24:00 (Server Time).
1. Each round of Apex Arena may feature doctors from 1-4 Kingdoms competing together.
2. During Apex Arena, eligible doctors can participate.

pages.title: Arena of Fate - Arenas · Last Asylum Wiki

2. Entry to the Advanced Arena requires Heroes' total Might to rank in the top 200 of their Kingdom.

pages.title: Triangular Arena - Arenas · Last Asylum Wiki
highlights: 4 arenas: entry level, free battles and rewards.

2. Match Lineup: Set up 3 teams for the Arena.

2. Configure and save separate attack and defense lineups to tackle different challenges.
